public_inputs: Original252 eight-frame public history, actual local candidates/selected anchor, received delayed peer positions/velocities/plans, original GRU path, original public belief CV. No true future, branch labels, privileged current peer plans or cost labels are passed to the model.
scheduling: Copy all sequential local-selection calls; run shadow forecasts only after original DN-MPC plan returns. Never overwrite plan/actions, deadlines or CBF parameters. Missing received peer plans are logged and skipped, never filled with zero or privileged plans.
data_use: Two fixed historical regression records only. No fitting, model/seed selection, candidate expansion or reserved holdout access. This is not generalization evidence.
required: Two independent replay processes; exact historical trajectories and plain commands/plans; all supported sequential calls forecast; off/refusal zero model reads; actual checkpoint load/forward fault paths exercised; source/checkpoint/capsule integrity; post-archive independent public context and inference audit.
remaining: Active sequential local-selector integration, self-generated candidates, independent new-data model decision qualification, untouched holdout and original full Levels/new-scene paired capture/safety/latency validation. local CBF remains empirical, not a new formal guarantee.
